question: Which world’s first Digital Tribal University was launched by Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Durgadas Uikey in New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adi Sanskriti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Durgadas Uikey launched the world’s first Digital Tribal University, Adi Sanskriti, at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adi Sanskriti is a digital academy and e-learning platform designed to promote tribal art, culture, crafts, and knowledge systems to a global audience.**
 
• The platform also includes an online marketplace to support tribal communities’ livelihoods and the preservation of their heritage.
 
• The Minister emphasized that the university would create new opportunities for cultural preservation and economic empowerment at the grassroots level.
 
• The initiative was discussed during the national conference on Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan, addressing the preservation of tribal heritage and ensuring dignity for tribal communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Adi Sanskriti__

 __
 
• The world’s first Digital Tribal University, created to preserve and promote tribal culture, arts, and crafts through digital platforms and online marketplaces.
 
 
 
• Tribal Heritage Preservation__
 __
 
• Ensuring that preserving tribal heritage is not just about safeguarding culture but also empowering communities through dignified opportunities and livelihoods.
 
 
 
• Integrated Tribal Development Agency__
 
 
• An organization supporting the upliftment of tribal communities by addressing their socio-economic challenges, as discussed during the Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan conference.
